concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-account-structure-resources-financial-products]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms example separating regional platform accounts, liable/grant resources and user account holders, balance accounts, payment instruments, transfer instruments, legal entities and business lines; examples do not prove product grants or money movement.
warnings: Food-delivery resource counts, locations and actors are illustrative; avoid treating them as a universal account structure.
Additional financial products and described account-holder capabilities are not proof of current eligibility, verification or enabled status.
